artifact_or_test_id: Pilot spec 23z5n exact Mermaid fence, read-only Node edge oracle for AC-1/AC-2
command_or_fixture: Pilot spec 23z5n exact Mermaid fence, read-only Node edge oracle for AC-1/AC-2
counterexample_or_failure_condition: the approval predates an affected repair or is not independently grounded
expected: Both supported directions preserve all eight labeled edges; invalid statements fall back as a complete block.
known_bad_detection_method: Synthetically retargeting security → reassess to security → QA kept 7 nodes/8 edges and failed the exact edge oracle. Skipping an unsupported edge also failed.
limitations: Feasibility oracle and current specimen only. Renderer effects, live browser and accessibility are delivery obligations.
observed: Read-only Node check on the pilot found seven labels, eight edges and four incoming reviewers for LR and TD. A seven-edge partial parse and a count-preserving retargeted security edge failed the endpoint oracle. The exact checks support the visual outcome on both planned routes and preserving ordinary source.
proposition: qa-reviewer approves the current affected scope
safety_and_authorization: Local review evidence only; no external side effects.

command_or_fixture: Node subprocess calling WFDS.renderMarkdownish with real 23z5n pilot and shipped ELK layered RIGHT
counterexample_or_failure_condition: the approval predates an affected repair or is not independently grounded
expected: The current renderer preserves code; the shipped layout handles the pilot, including all four prerequisites before readiness.
known_bad_detection_method: An assertion that the current WFDS document has an SVG failed on the exact pilot fence. An ordinary JS fence and surrounding paragraphs stayed readable.
limitations: Current production renderer and offline layout exercised separately. Both detail routes inspected statically; browser, offline integration and accessibility await delivery.
observed: Production WFDS gave ordinary pre/code for both the pilot and a JS control, preserving adjacent paragraphs. ELK yielded finite positions for seven nodes and routed all eight edges offline. The wave and change callbacks open the same DocDialog. Exact edges and all-or-source behavior make the proposed change feasible.
proposition: code-reviewer approves the current affected scope
safety_and_authorization: Local review evidence only; no external side effects.

artifact_or_test_id: Node VM with shipped React and WFDS.renderMarkdownish, pilot 23z5n; DocDialog dashboard.js:4184
command_or_fixture: Node VM with shipped React and WFDS.renderMarkdownish, pilot 23z5n; DocDialog dashboard.js:4184
counterexample_or_failure_condition: the approval predates an affected repair or is not independently grounded
expected: Unknown syntax preserves complete source with all prerequisites, while adjacent Markdown survives.

limitations: Readiness proof only. Budget enforcement, fixed SVG elements, layout freshness, offline browser and accessibility remain delivery work.

artifact_or_test_id: Vendored React WFDS.renderMarkdownish Node probe; pilot 23z5n amid list/ordinary fence; seed 170 and wave dependencies
command_or_fixture: Vendored React WFDS.renderMarkdownish Node probe; pilot 23z5n amid list/ordinary fence; seed 170 and wave dependencies
counterexample_or_failure_condition: the approval predates an affected repair or is not independently grounded
expected: Pilot has four incoming checks; ordinary Markdown remains intact and the optional chart cannot replace machine declarations.
known_bad_detection_method: Deleting only security → reassess retained seven nodes but fell from eight edges/four join predecessors to seven edges/three predecessors, which the endpoint checks detected.
limitations: Current comment/Markdown and static route inspection, no delivered browser display or throughput claim.

The plan preserves the typed Depends On declaration and existing required sections alongside optional diagrams. Source plus a sentence serves existing users but does not meet the operator’s offline visual goal.
proposition: docs-contract-reviewer approves the current affected scope

artifact_or_test_id: Chair production WFDS Node control on 23z5n exact fence and ordinary text; 24237 four current specialist approvals plus red-team and reality-checker
command_or_fixture: Chair production WFDS Node control on 23z5n exact fence and ordinary text; 24237 four current specialist approvals plus red-team and reality-checker
counterexample_or_failure_condition: the approval predates an affected repair or is not independently grounded
expected: The exact case exposes an unmet visual goal; the proposed acceptance path checks all four prerequisites remain visible and accessible without losing existing grammar.
known_bad_detection_method: Chair’s asserted seven-edge expected count failed against the real pilot’s eight. QA independently detected a miswired endpoint while preserving the totals.
limitations: Readiness assessment only. Same host and model family on selected fixture; no claim about production integration, human throughput or reviewer quality.
observed: Chair reproduced pre/code on pilot and ordinary fence and eight relationships. QA’s retargeted-edge control proved counts alone insufficient; security and docs found whole-source fallback feasible and code demonstrated shipped offline layout. Architecture, security, QA, docs and reality seats agreed the spec can establish the wave objective. Exact endpoint pairs and actual wave/spec routes are delivery checks. Source plus a join sentence is cheaper but lacks the requested visual.
proposition: council-readiness approves the current affected scope
safety_and_authorization: Local review evidence only; no external side effects.

artifact_or_test_id: dashboard-dependency-diagrams.cjs via node, and unittest test_dashboard_server.py -k RenderMarkdownish
command_or_fixture: dashboard-dependency-diagrams.cjs via node, and unittest test_dashboard_server.py -k RenderMarkdownish
counterexample_or_failure_condition: the approval predates an affected repair or is not independently grounded
expected: All visible relationships match labeled directed edges, including docs/code/QA/security to reassess. Stale completion cannot overwrite a replacement document.
known_bad_detection_method: In an isolated scratch copy only e7 was redirected to Code. The real-ELK check exited 1 and named Security → Code versus Security → Reassess.
limitations: Core execution uses real ELK and WFDS with a React harness. QA independently checks mounted browser behavior.
observed: The shipped WFDS and ELK produced the exact eight directed connections. Rewiring only e7 to Code preserved counts and accessible input but the drawing check failed with a misdirected Security connection. Ten Markdown tests ran with one unrelated skip and no failures. Async cleanup, source-keyed rerender, request rejection, limits and ordinary fences were checked.
proposition: code-reviewer approves the current affected scope
safety_and_authorization: Local review evidence only; no external side effects.

artifact_or_test_id: WFDS.renderMarkdownish Node direct output-type probes and shipped dashboard-dependency-diagrams.cjs with actual ELK
command_or_fixture: WFDS.renderMarkdownish Node direct output-type probes and shipped dashboard-dependency-diagrams.cjs with actual ELK
counterexample_or_failure_condition: the approval predates an affected repair or is not independently grounded
expected: Supported bounded inputs may reach layout; disallowed statements and inputs beyond budgets remain inert complete source.
known_bad_detection_method: Changing document cap in memory from <8 to <9 caused the direct-type count assertion to fail 9 versus 8. Confirmed 32 nodes, 64 statements and 8192 string units at the boundary.
limitations: Independent Node VM and shipped ELK, no separate browser/network trace or resource benchmark by this reviewer. QA covers actual browser operations.
observed: Seven unsupported/oversized cases and an unclosed fence remained direct pre/code with original source. Adjacent diagram/paragraph survived. Exact bounds were eligible and the ninth valid graph stayed source. Rendering uses fixed elements, text children and local ELK. No blocking security finding.
proposition: security-reviewer approves the current affected scope
safety_and_authorization: Local review evidence only; no external side effects.

artifact_or_test_id: Independent QA headless Chrome spec and wave dialog at 390 px; RenderMarkdownishDependencyDiagramTests and ELK driver with reversed edges; seed/prompt/template text comparison
command_or_fixture: Independent QA headless Chrome spec and wave dialog at 390 px; RenderMarkdownishDependencyDiagramTests and ELK driver with reversed edges; seed/prompt/template text comparison
counterexample_or_failure_condition: the approval predates an affected repair or is not independently grounded
expected: An operator can follow the same prerequisite order visually and as text on both routes; unsupported input stays source and simple linear planning remains available.
known_bad_detection_method: Swapping source/target in the reviewer’s disposable copy preserved edge and node counts but the shipped real-ELK driver failed exactly at the SVG endpoint comparison. Browser probes checked returning complete source on unsupported and oversized cases.
limitations: Headless Chrome on one host at a narrow viewport. No screen-reader user study or measured throughput improvement; full framework suite is a separate qualification.
observed: Seven spec nodes and all eight geometric and accessible directed pairs matched; the wave displayed both prerequisite pairs. All four reviewers joined at reassessment. The second graphic had a distinct marker, source fallback and adjacent ordinary Markdown remained intact, and there were zero foreign requests or dialog overflow. Both template copies and both guidance surfaces matched. QA confirms the intent outcome as achieved.
proposition: qa-reviewer approves the current affected scope
safety_and_authorization: Local review evidence only; no external side effects.
